item.anchors.old_lantern.desc: It remembers someone searching for the way home.
item.anchors.music_box.desc: A lullaby sung in a dark room. Something else can hear it too.
item.anchors.rag_doll.desc: It remembers a child who was kept safe. It will take a blow for you.
message.anchors.music_box_on: The music box begins to play...
message.anchors.doll_saved: The doll took the blow. It looks a little more like you now.
message.anchors.stage_2: Something is watching from the dark.
command.anchors.house.fail: Could not find a flat dry spot nearby. Try again from another place.
message.anchors.ritual_wrong: The altar stays silent. The order must be different.
message.anchors.ritual_step_1: The first candle burns. The light has shown them the way.
message.anchors.ritual_step_2: The second candle burns. The lullaby sounds once more.
item.anchors.inverted_cross.desc: It must take its place in the frame above the altar.
message.anchors.frame_empty: The frame is empty. Something is missing here.
message.anchors.cross_placed: The cross has taken its place. The altar stirs.
message.anchors.ritual_no_cross: The altar stays asleep. The frame above it is still empty.
